result: ProjectionLayoutRenderer now renders a single canonical LayoutNode only when the exact contribution ID is present in the eligible contribution map and resolveContributionRenderer accepts its generated semantic/renderer binding. Missing, foreign-keyed, malformed, unknown, or mismatched contributions fail closed before a layout-single wrapper is created. The trusted renderer registry is propagated through MissionCanvasFrame and MissionCanvasRenderer, while Core/controller ownership of eligibility, exact Workstream/Attachment authority, revision/cursor freshness, and recomposition remains unchanged.

implementation: ProjectionLayoutRenderer calls the named resolveContributionRenderer seam before accepting a contribution host and requires the map key and ResolvedContribution.contribution_id to match exactly.

A canonical tree with an omitted, foreign-keyed, unavailable, malformed, unknown-renderer, or semantic-mismatched contribution is refused as a unit, preventing split/stack/grid/inspector geometry from reserving a dead gap; the renderer never locally filters, reflows, invents, or substitutes a contribution.

Trusted registry propagation is explicit through recursive ProjectionLayoutRenderer calls, MissionCanvasFrame, and MissionCanvasRenderer, so the production custom registry—not a fixture-only resolver—guards the render path.

Tabs and inspector entries use the same trusted contribution lookup, preserving recursive canonical LayoutNode rendering and preventing untrusted entries from becoming tabs, headings, borders, or hosts.

negative_cases.missing_contribution_id: A single LayoutNode pointing to an omitted ID produces no layout-single wrapper, rendered host, or contribution marker. A nested split containing the omitted ID produces no split or split-child geometry.
negative_cases.foreign_keyed_contribution: A contribution stored under a key whose DTO contribution_id differs from the LayoutNode ID is rejected; the renderer does not repair the map or render the foreign DTO.
negative_cases.unknown_renderer_binding: resolveContributionRenderer rejects the unknown binding and the single node produces no host; no generic or substitute panel is rendered.
negative_cases.semantic_binding_mismatch: A trusted renderer with a non-allowlisted semantic binding is rejected before the single host is created.
negative_cases.missing_authority: A ResolvedContribution without its generated AuthorityDescriptor is rejected by the trusted resolver and produces no layout geometry.
negative_cases.foreign_scope_stale_revision_cursor_unav: These authority-bearing conditions remain fail-closed at the generated transport and MissionCanvasProjectionController boundary; existing hostile projection-controller, transport, event, and invalidation checks reject foreign Workstream/Attachment scope, stale projection/layout/cursor watermarks, and unavailable operation/capability paths before this renderer receives canonical projection data. The renderer does not infer or repair scope.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Core omission diagnostics and canonical layout omit empty optional contributions; Desktop consumes the resulting eligible map and does not create a replacement contribution or reserved node.

acceptance: Missing contribution ID fails closed with no reserved geometry.
Omitted contribution IDs cannot leave DOM nodes, headings, borders, or gaps.
Unknown semantic or renderer binding fails closed; no substitute panel is rendered.

Resize mutations call focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate rather than changing canonical layout locally; this slice adds no local layout mutation path and leaves the generated mutation operation to the existing Desktop runtime seam.
